items.titleZh: 安东内利坦言夺冠后过于自信，付出失误代价
items.summaryZh: 安东内利承认在锁定F1年度冠军后自己“过于自信”，并因此犯下至少一次在争冠压力下不会出现的代价高昂的失误。自一个月前在墨西哥夺冠以来，他已连续两场比赛未能登上领奖台。
items.originalTitle: 'I was overconfident' - Antonelli battling post-title hangover
items.summaryEn: Antonelli admitted he was "overconfident" after sealing his Formula 1 title and has since made at least one costly error he would not have made had he still been in a championship fight. He has not been on the podium since winning the title in Mexico a month ago.
detailZh: 安东内利承认，在锁定F1年度冠军后自己“过于自信”，并因此犯下至少一次在争冠压力下不会出现的代价高昂的失误。
自一个月前在墨西哥夺冠以来，安东内利因两次不同的失误连续两场比赛未能登上领奖台；这是他在 otherwise 出色的2026赛季中首次连续两场无缘领奖台。
安东内利此前表示，在奥斯汀站他驾驶得异常紧张，因为他正处于夺冠边缘，而那个周末他还在病后恢复，这也对他不利。而那个周日，他仍从令人失望的排位赛中恢复过来并夺冠。
但在卡塔尔站，他透露夺冠也影响了他的驾驶，他认为这导致了他在巴西站的失误——当时他在领先时受到诺里斯压力后打滑退赛。
安东内利表示：“我一直很享受，但与此同时也没有那么享受，因为显然过去的几场比赛并不顺利，尽管我认为速度是有的。”
“知道冠军争夺已经结束，感觉有点奇怪，当然比赛时压力会小一些，但感觉并不完全一样。”
“所以我完全没有抱怨；我很高兴能处在这个位置。但确实，当你提前赢得冠军后，很容易在回到车里时降低一点强度和专注度。”
“这就是为什么我觉得，尤其是在巴西，如果我当时还在为冠军而战，比赛中犯的错误可能就不会发生。但当时我过于自信，同时那一刻也缺乏一点专注，然后错误就发生了。”
所以我觉得，在压力之下我确实能够更加专注，但这种情况对我来说也是全新的，所以我一直在努力从中学习，希望这两场比赛我能以非常高的[注]完赛。
安东内利并非第一位在夺冠后遭遇“冠军后遗症”的车手。他的梅赛德斯前任刘易斯·汉密尔顿在2015年强势锁定总冠军后，接下来三场比赛的胜利全部被梅赛德斯队友尼科·罗斯伯格夺走。
两年后，他在击败塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔和法拉利提前锁定总冠军后，在巴西站遭遇了一次不符合他水准的排位赛撞车。
迈克尔·舒马赫在2004年最具统治力的总冠军征程收官阶段尤为混乱，在中国站的排位赛和正赛中均发生打转，还遭遇了爆胎并与克里斯蒂安·克莱恩相撞。
他在英特拉格斯排位赛中撞车，又在蒙扎开场圈打转，把胜利拱手让给了整个赛季都被他压制的对手们。
安东内利在与马克斯·维斯塔潘争夺胜利的战斗中掉队，最终在拉斯维加斯获得第四名——他战术性地收油以留在维斯塔潘身后获取超车模式，结果却触发了极端的能量回收，导致他后来在直道上电池耗尽。
“我们进行了分析，并从中得出结论，在这方面我们应该让系统更加稳健，”安东内利在卡塔尔解释道。
“这一切都始于5号弯，因为在5号弯我也收了一次油，基本上收油让系统回收了大量能量，所以基本上第二次收油时我的回收额度已经归零，因此我在减速弯无法回收任何能量，这就是为什么我最后电池没电了。”
"车队已经在着手处理这个问题，试图让系统在这类场景下更加稳健，并且告诉动力单元‘看，如果我要在这里抬油门，那就什么都别做’。
"我没有深入了解细节，因为非常复杂，但据他们告诉我，他们加了一个安全功能，应该不会再让那种情况发生了。
"所以系统应该会稳健得多，那应该能让我正常比赛，因为归根结底我想做的就是留在后面保住超车机会，并在直道上获得尾流，从而给自己创造最好的机会。
"但因为那两次抬油门，就足以触发系统，把我置于非常不利的位置。"
队友乔治·拉塞尔因为对安东内利的一次超车失败而失去了获胜机会，当时他正试图跟上领跑者维斯塔潘。
他在卡塔尔承认：“我现在的风险指数可能有点太高了，因为我就是想要去争取这些大成绩，在赛季末段留下一些高光时刻。”
“如果那是赛季第一场比赛，我绝对不会在还剩两圈时去尝试那个动作。但赛季还剩两场比赛，我有点想去拼一下。”
他解释说，他原本把5号弯入口处的一个凸起当作那个弯道刹车点的参照物，但关键的是，当他走到弯道内侧时，就失去了那个参照物。
拉塞尔解释道：“我会撞到颠簸处然后刹车，接着我切入那个弯道的内侧，那里没有颠簸。当我刹车时，我心想：‘天哪，我刚刚刹车太晚了。’”
“事后看来总是很容易，但那次事故完全是我的责任。”
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli admitted he was "overconfident" after sealing his Formula 1 title, and has since made at least one costly error he wouldn't have made had he still been in a championship fight.

Antonelli hasn't been on the podium since he won the title in Mexico a month ago due to two different errors; the first time he's gone two consecutive races without a podium in an otherwise sublime 2026.

Antonelli previously said that at Austin he was driving unusually tense because he was on the cusp of the title, not helped by the fact he was also recovering from an illness that weekend. And on that Sunday he still managed to recover from a disappointing qualifying to win.

But in Qatar, he revealed that winning the title has also had an impact on his driving, believing it contributed to the error he made in Brazil, where he spun out of the race lead while under pressure from Lando Norris.
"I've been enjoying but I've not been enjoying at the same time, because obviously the past races haven't gone well, I would say, despite having the pace," Antonelli said.
"It kind of feels a little bit weird knowing that the championship is already over, and of course you race with less pressure, but it's not quite the same.

"So I'm not complaining at all; I'm happy to be in this position. But definitely when you win the championship in advance, it's really easy to drop a bit of intensity and a bit of focus as well, then when you go back in the car.

"And that's why I feel like, mainly in Brazil, the mistake that I did in the race probably wouldn't have happened if I was still fighting for the championship. But there I was overconfident, but as well I had a bit of a lack of focus in the moment and then the mistake happened.

"So I feel like definitely under pressure I'm able to have a higher focus, but also it's something new for me, this scenario, so I've been trying to learn from it, and hopefully these two races I can finish on a very high [note]."

Antonelli isn't the first champion to suffer a post-title hangover. His Mercedes predecessor, Lewis Hamilton, was beaten to victory in all three races by Mercedes team-mate Nico Rosberg after his dominant 2015 title victory was sealed.
Two years later, he had an uncharacteristic qualifying crash in Brazil after beating Sebastian Vettel and Ferrari to an early crown.

Michael Schumacher had a particularly messy end to his most dominant title victory in 2004, spinning in both qualifying and the race in China, as well as picking up a puncture and colliding with Christian Klien.
He crashed in qualifying at Interlagos and spun at Monza on the opening lap, leaving victories on the table for rivals he'd crushed all season.

Antonelli dropped out of a fight with Max Verstappen for the win and finished fourth in Las Vegas after he tactically lifted to stay behind Verstappen to get overtake mode, only for that to trigger extreme harvesting that later left him with no battery on the straight.
"We analysed and we came away [from] that [and concluded] on that regard we should make the system a bit more robust," Antonelli explained in Qatar.

"It all started from Turn 5 because also in Turn 5 I had a lift and basically by lifting the system harvested loads of energy, so basically by doing the second lift I ended up with zero harvest left so I couldn't harvest any energy in the chicane and then that's why I ended up with no battery.

"The team has been already working on it on trying to make the system more robust in those kinds of scenarios and in order to say to the power unit 'look if [I'm] going to lift at this point just don't do anything'.
"I didn't get into details because it's very complicated, but from what they told me, they put a safety feature that shouldn't make that happen anymore.

"So should be [that] the system should be much more robust, and that should allow me to race normally, because at the end what I was trying to do is staying behind to keep the overtake and have the tow for the straight in order to give myself the best opportunity.
"But because of the two lifts, that was enough to trigger the system and put me in a very unfavourable position."
Team-mate George Russell lost his victory chance because of a failed overtake on Antonelli, while trying to keep touch with race leader Verstappen.
He admitted in Qatar "My risk dial is probably a bit too high at the moment because I'm just wanting to go for these big results and get some highlights on the board towards the end of the season.
"If that was race one of the season, there's no way I would have gone for that move with two laps remaining. But two races to go in the season, I kind of wanted to go for it."
He explained he was using a bump on the entry to Turn 5 as a reference for his braking point for that corner, but he crucially lost that when he went to the inside of the corner.
"I'd hit the bump and then I would brake, and I went on the inside of that corner, and there was no bump. When I braked, I was like, "Jeez, I've just braked way too late here," Russell explained.
"It's always easy in hindsight, but that incident was all on me."

items.originalTitle: Max Verstappen without Gianpiero Lambiase at Qatar GP as Tom Hart steps in
detailZh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在卡塔尔大奖赛上没有吉安皮耶罗·兰比亚塞，汤姆·哈特临时顶替
兰比亚塞原本计划在2026年最后两场F1比赛中担任维斯塔潘的工程师，但由于个人原因将缺席卡塔尔站
马克斯·维斯塔潘在本周末的卢塞尔国际赛道上将没有他的常任副手吉安皮耶罗·兰比亚塞。红牛队已经为本赛季后半段选择了轮换制度，主要是为了让汤姆·哈特能够适应这个角色，以便于他预期的永久任命，同时兰比亚塞仍然留在车队中
最初的计划是让兰比亚塞作为维斯塔潘的赛事工程师，覆盖本赛季最后两场大奖赛，同时他还担任红牛车队赛车部门负责人，但由于个人原因他将缺席卡塔尔站。车队告诉Motorsport.com，如果兰比亚塞的个人情况允许，他预计将在阿布扎比回归
Lambiase预计将在2027年转会至迈凯轮之前被安排休假。尽管红牛尚未正式宣布，但这使得哈特很可能会在2027赛季开始时成为维斯塔潘的永久赛车工程师。
哈特自2013年以来一直为红牛效力，原本他正前往威廉姆斯车队，但维斯塔潘内部表示更倾向于哈特作为Lambiase的替代者。红牛随后设法阻止了哈特前往位于格罗夫的团队的计划，他原本将成为亚历山大·阿隆索的赛车工程师。
哈特与这位四次世界冠军合作的首场比赛就遇到了一些挑战。在奥斯汀，无线电连接出现了技术问题，而在巴西，维斯塔潘在开场阶段后反复抱怨小红牛22赛车有一种奇怪的感觉。在拉斯维加斯，虽然维斯塔潘和哈特之间的沟通已经显得相当好，但比赛仍然非常混乱。
维斯塔潘对哈特评价积极，他表示尽管面临这些挑战，哈特还是留下了“良好的印象”。
如何适应F1的能量管理要求
维斯塔潘、红牛车队、乔治·拉塞尔、梅赛德斯
在拉斯维加斯，维斯塔潘因为‘智胜’梅赛德斯车队而受到赞誉，正如红牛车队负责人劳伦特·梅基斯所说。尽管这位荷兰人仍然不是当前规则的粉丝，但他在与乔治·拉塞尔的较量中展现了他对能量管理的理解，他多次超越拉塞尔。
维斯塔潘的表现突出了红牛车队在能量匮乏赛道上DM01动力单元的进步，同时也展现了维斯塔潘如何运用他手中的工具——这与他赛季初在墨尔本的表现相比，似乎是一个进步。
“我认为我们所有人，包括车手和车队，在理解能量管理方面都变得更擅长了，但这是正常的，因为这是一项新的规定，”当被Motorsport.com在卡塔尔问到他在幕后采取了哪些步骤时，维斯塔潘说。
“当你回顾第一个周末的比赛时，我认为如果我们能回到过去，我们会做不同的事情。如果你回去却不知道该怎么做不同的事情，那也是不好的，所以这只是正常的进步，我会这么说。”
虽然维斯塔潘觉得拉斯维加斯的赛道布局非常适合小红牛22，但他预计卡塔尔将带来不同的挑战。卢塞尔国际赛道以高速弯角为主，这是维斯塔潘表示红牛车队今年在这一领域并不总是特别有竞争力的地方。
然而，在巴库红牛车队成功升级后，队友伊萨克·哈德贾认为车队现在应该在任何地方都具有竞争力。
detailEn: Max Verstappen without Gianpiero Lambiase at Qatar GP as Tom Hart steps in
Lambiase was originally scheduled to engineer Verstappen for the final two F1 races of 2026 but will miss Qatar due to personal circumstances

Max Verstappen will be without his regular right-hand man Gianpiero Lambiase this weekend at the Lusail International Circuit. Red Bull had already opted for a rotation system for the latter part of this Formula 1 season, primarily to allow Tom Hart to settle into the role ahead of his expected permanent appointment while Lambiase is still with the team.

The initial plan was for Lambiase to cover the final two grands prix of the season as Verstappen's race engineer, besides his duties as Red Bull’s head of racing, but he will be absent in Qatar due to personal circumstances. The team told Motorsport.com that Lambiase is expected to return in Abu Dhabi, provided his personal circumstances allow.

Lambiase is expected to be placed on gardening leave in 2027 ahead of his move to McLaren. While Red Bull has yet to formally announce it, this makes it very likely that Hart will become Verstappen's permanent race engineer as early as the start of the 2027 season.

Hart, who has worked for Red Bull since 2013, was on his way to Williams until Verstappen internally expressed his preference for Hart as Lambiase's replacement. Red Bull subsequently managed to reverse Hart's planned move to the Grove-based team, where he was due to become Alexander Albon's race engineer.

Hart’s first races working with the four-time world champion have presented several challenges. In Austin, there were technical problems with the radio connection, while in Brazil Verstappen repeatedly complained about a strange feeling in the RB22 after his opening stint. A particularly chaotic race unfolded in Las Vegas, although communication between Verstappen and Hart already appeared to be considerably better.
Verstappen has spoken positively about Hart, who he says has made a “good impression” despite those challenges.
How Verstappen has adapted to F1’s energy management demands
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

In Las Vegas, Verstappen was praised for  "outsmarting" Mercedes, as Red Bull team principal Laurent Mekies put it. Although the Dutchman is still not a fan of the current regulations, he demonstrated his understanding of energy management in his battle with George Russell, whom he repeatedly repassed.

Verstappen’s performance underlined the progress Red Bull has made with its DM01 power unit on energy-poor circuits, but also the extent to which Verstappen played with the tools at his disposal – something that also appeared to represent a step forward compared with the season opener in Melbourne.

“I think we all got better at it, drivers and teams, in understanding the energy management, but that's normal when it's a new regulation,” Verstappen said when asked by Motorsport.com in Qatar which steps he has taken behind the scenes.

“When you look at the first race weekend, I think if we go back, you would do things differently. It would also be bad if you go back and you wouldn't know what to do differently, so it's just normal progression, I would say.”

While Verstappen felt the layout in Las Vegas suited the RB22 well, he expects Qatar to present a different challenge. The Lusail International Circuit is dominated by high-speed corners, an area in which Verstappen says Red Bull has not always been particularly competitive this year.
However, following Red Bull's successful upgrade in Baku, team-mate Isack Hadjar believes the team should now be competitive everywhere.

items.originalTitle: Why Max Verstappen has ruled out Indy 500 entry
detailZh: 为什么维斯塔潘排除了参加印第安纳波利斯500赛的可能性
维斯塔潘表示参加印第安纳波利斯500赛的风险太高
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛车队，了解一级方程式新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的比赛分析。
四次一级方程式冠军维斯塔潘已经排除了在印第安纳波利斯500赛中参赛的可能性，他提到了纳尔逊·皮克特在赛道上的事故对赛车手的长期影响。
皮奎特，维斯塔潘搭档凯莉·皮奎特的父亲，在1992年印第安纳波利斯500赛事的练习赛中发生撞车，腿部和脚部受到严重伤害，需要数月时间进行康复。
维斯塔潘在上周末赢得拉斯维加斯大奖赛之后，在卡塔尔大奖赛周末之前接受媒体采访时，被问及他是否有可能参加这场标志性的赛事。这座罪恶之城街道上的比赛被比作是印第安纳赛车系列赛的比赛。
但红牛车手表示这并没有改变他的想法。
“不，但也不是我不会擅长它。只是风险管理的考虑，这就是为什么我不想参加。我喜欢观看比赛，但我也知道发生碰撞的风险非常高，我有足够的例子。”维斯塔潘说。
“即使如此，我的岳父在那儿也发生过严重的车祸，看到他在那次车祸后余生是如何度过的，这是我不愿意在已经参加F1和GT3赛车的同时承担的风险。”
“在某个时刻，你已经承担了很多风险，所以有时候有几个周末你不需要一直处于极限状态是很好的。”
“这位荷兰人透露了他的计划，在未来参加更多耐力赛，尽管他说这取决于能否组建正确的团队。”
“好吧，首先，总是从预算开始的。我不喜欢全部用我自己的钱包支付。不管你有多少钱，每个人都不喜欢这样，”他说。
“我喜欢参加所有的耐力赛，但同时也喜欢以正确的方式参加，做好充分的准备，与正确的车队一起参加。我不是去那里只是参加比赛的，我是去那里赢的。”
维斯塔潘以304分进入赛季最后两场比赛，在车手积分榜上排名第二。法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿以267分排名第三，梅赛德斯的乔治·罗素和麦克拉伦的兰多·诺里斯分别排名第四和第五，两人都是264分。
detailEn: Why Max Verstappen has ruled out Indy 500 entry
Verstappen says the risk is too high to enter the Indianapolis 500
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Four-time Formula 1 champion Max Verstappen has ruled out racing in the Indianapolis 500, citing the lasting effects of Nelson Piquet's crash at the Speedway.
Piquet, the father of Verstappen's partner Kelly Piquet, suffered serious injuries to his legs and feet when he crashed in practice for the 1992 Indy 500, and needed months of rehabilitation.

Verstappen was asked about the possibility of him entering the iconic race while speaking to the media ahead of the Qatar Grand Prix weekend, after he won the Las Vegas Grand Prix last weekend. The race around the streets of Sin City featured racing that has been likened to that of the IndyCar Series.
But the Red Bull driver said that had not changed his mind.

"No, but it's also not that I won't be good at it. It's just the risk management, that's why I don't want to do it. I like watching it, but I also know there is a very high risk involved by crashing, and I've had plenty of examples," Verstappen said.

"Even, of course, my father-in-law had a big crash there, and seeing how he had to live for the rest of his life after that crash is some risk that I'm not willing to take while already doing F1 and racing in GT3.
"At one point you're taking already a lot of risk, so sometimes it's good to have a few weekends where you don't need to be on the limit all the time."
The Dutchman did reveal his plans to race more endurance events in the future, although he said it would depend on getting the right package together.
"Well, it always starts with budget, first of all. I don't like to fully pay it out of my own wallet. Everyone doesn't like that, it doesn't matter how much you have," he said.

"I like to do all the endurance races, but at the same time I also like to do it in the proper way, be well prepared, doing it with the right team. I'm not there to just participate, I'm there to win."

Verstappen heads into the final two races of the season second in the drivers' championship on 304 points. Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton sits third with 267 points, and Mercedes' George Russell and McLaren's Lando Norris are fourth and fifth, both on 264 points.

detailZh: 刘易斯·汉密尔顿确认在拉斯维加斯碰撞后与查尔斯·勒克莱尔进行了“积极”的谈话
法拉利车手表示，在拉斯维加斯的碰撞之后，他和查尔斯·勒克莱尔坐下来进行了交谈
对于法拉利车迷来说。这是最新的Scuderia 法拉利 F1新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远地方的赛事反应
七届一级方程式冠军刘易斯·汉密尔顿表示，自拉斯维加斯大奖赛以来，法拉利的谈话一直“积极”，并且相信他和他的队友查尔斯·勒克莱尔可以在最近的碰撞之后一起前进。
勒克莱尔在拉斯维加斯将汉密尔顿旋转了一圈，而在墨西哥大奖赛三周后的另一场碰撞中，队友们争夺第六名。勒克莱尔被处以10秒罚时，最终排名第10，而汉密尔顿恢复到第七名。
车队负责人弗雷德·瓦瑟尔将这次事件称为"对团队的缺乏尊重"，并表示墨西哥之后法拉利的消息已经非常明确。
在卡塔尔接受媒体采访时，汉密尔顿没有详细说明之后说了什么，但表示讨论进行得很顺利。
"一切都在内部。但讨论得很好，"他说。"积极的，是的。一直都很积极。查尔斯和我之前也坐在这里进行了很好的讨论。"
问及这对搭档是否现在可以和谐地前进，汉密尔顿表示明确。
"是的，是的。我们会找到解决办法的。你知道，毕竟我们是队友，我们总是从这些经历中学习，虽然可能看起来不是这样，"他说。
"但我们会从这个困难时期学到一些东西，我仍然相信我们在幕后建立和努力追求的一切。
汉密尔顿表示他和勒克莱尔已经一起经历了每一场比赛的每一个"弯道"，但他承认没有计划可以覆盖赛道上的每一个情况。
“你永远无法覆盖一切，因为每个场景都是不同的，”他说。
“总会有一些新情况是你可能没有预料到的。但你也必须运用你的直觉，并且始终要有一个团队在核心。”
他认为，艰难的时刻会让法拉利从长远来看变得更强大。
“这对弗雷德、查尔斯和我来说无疑是极具挑战性的时期。但这些正是你真正学习和更紧密团结在一起的时刻，通过交谈和沟通，以及那些坐下来讨论的时刻，”汉密尔顿说。
这位英国人也期待着在冬季与勒克莱尔保持联系，那时两人都"没有比赛"，勒克莱尔也正在适应作为新父亲的生活。
"我对明年我们能够共同努力并取得更好的成绩没有疑问。我们希望能够建立更好的流程，以便真正提升车队," 他说。
法拉利在最后两场比赛中，以车队锦标赛第二的位置进入，领先红牛77分。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton confirms "positive" talks with Charles Leclerc after Las Vegas clash
The Ferrari driver says he and Charles Leclerc have sat down together following their collision in Las Vegas
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

Seven-time Formula 1 champion Lewis Hamilton says Ferrari's talks since the Las Vegas Grand Prix have been "positive", and believes he and his team-mate Charles Leclerc can move forward together after their latest clash.

Leclerc spun Hamilton around while the team-mates fought over sixth place in Las Vegas, three weeks after another clash at the Mexican Grand Prix. Leclerc was given a 10-second penalty and finished 10th, while Hamilton recovered to seventh.
Team principal Fred Vasseur called the incident "a lack of respect for the team", and said Ferrari's message after Mexico had been clear.
Speaking to the media in Qatar, Hamilton would not go into detail about what had been said since, but made it clear the discussions had gone well.
"Everything stays internal. But good discussions," he said. "Positive, yeah. It's been positive. Charles and I sat here earlier on and had a good discussion as well."
Asked whether the pair could now move forward in harmony, Hamilton was clear.
"I do. I do. We're going to figure it out. You know, we're team-mates at the end of the day, and we do always learn from these experiences, while maybe it doesn't necessarily look like it," he said.
"But there will be learnings that we take from this difficult period, and I still believe in everything we're building and working towards in the background."
Hamilton said he and Leclerc had already been through every race "corner by corner", but admitted no plan could cover every situation on track.
"You can never cover everything, because every scenario is different," he said.
"There's always going to be something new that you maybe haven't foreseen. But also you have to use your instinct, and at the core of it, always have to have the team."
He believes the difficult moments will make Ferrari stronger in the long run.

"These are definitely very, very challenging times for Fred and Charles and I. But these are the moments that you really learn and grow closer together, through conversation and communicating and having those sit-downs," Hamilton said.
The Briton also expects to stay in touch with Leclerc over the winter, when the pair are "out of competition" and Leclerc is settling into life as a new father.
"I have no doubts that next year we'll come back working hard together and in a better place. We'll hopefully put better processes in place so that we can really elevate the team," he said.
Ferrari goes into the final two races second in the constructors' championship, 77 points ahead of Red Bull.

赛道之外的赛车文化。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计与那些让赛车不止于运动的故事。
前红牛车队领队兼首席执行官克里斯蒂安·霍纳及其妻子、辣妹组合成员杰里·哈利维尔据信已买下埃奇科特庄园，这座历史悠久的北安普敦郡庄园曾出现在英国广播公司的《傲慢与偏见》中。
据《每日邮报》报道，这对夫妇据称在击败约5200万英镑的竞标后拿下了这座1700英亩的庄园。据报道，今年夏天一份4500万英镑的较早报价被拒绝，当时另一位买家出价更高，随后霍纳夫妇带着更高的报价回归。最终价格尚未确认。
这座一级保护建筑曾在英国广播公司1995年改编的简·奥斯汀小说中用作内瑟菲尔德庄园，还曾被赠予克利夫斯的安妮，作为她与亨利八世离婚协议的一部分。
该庄园包括两个专业赛马场、训练跑道、围场和一条赛马跑道，预计将成为他们赛马业务的基地。
杰里·霍纳与红牛车队领队克里斯蒂安·霍纳
主宅有八间卧室，居住面积超过25000平方英尺。目前尚不清楚此次购买是否包括散布在更广阔庄园各处的全部31栋小屋和住宅。
此举发生在霍纳于2025年7月被红牛解雇一年多之后，此前他领导这支米尔顿凯恩斯车队长达20年。
根据公司账目，据信他获得了约8000万英镑的“离职补偿”。
这位英国车手今年早些时候在银石举行的英国大奖赛上重返F1围场，并在那里谈到了可能重返锦标赛的话题。他告诉天空体育：“我很享受这段离开的时间。我在红牛车队连续工作了20年。在那之前我显然还做过其他事情，所以这是我第一次有机会从无休止的忙碌中抽身出来。”
“但对我来说，我只会考虑做正确的事，也就是真正有机会在最后赢得胜利的事情。”
detailEn: Christian Horner and Geri Halliwell reportedly snap up "Pride and Prejudice" mansion
The former Red Bull boss and his wife Geri Halliwell have reportedly bought Edgcote House, a Grade I-listed Northamptonshire estate with its own racecourse
Geri Horner and Christian Horner at the World Premiere of F1 The Movie
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.

Former Red Bull Racing team principal and CEO Christian Horner and his wife, Spice Girl Geri Halliwell, are understood to have bought Edgcote House, the historic Northamptonshire estate that appeared in the BBC's Pride and Prejudice.

The couple are said to have secured the 1,700-acre estate after beating a rival bid of around £52million, according to the Daily Mail. An earlier offer of £45million was reportedly turned down in the summer, when another buyer bid higher, before the Horners returned with a bigger offer. The final price has not been confirmed.
The Grade I-listed house was used as Netherfield in the BBC's 1995 adaptation of the Jane Austen novel, and was once given to Anne of Cleves as part of her divorce settlement from Henry VIII.
The estate includes two professional racing yards, gallops, paddocks and a racecourse, and is expected to become the base for their horse racing operation.
Geri Horner with Christian Horner, Team Principal, Red Bull Racing
The main house has eight bedrooms and more than 25,000 square feet of living space. It is unclear whether the purchase includes all of the 31 cottages and houses dotted around the wider estate.
The move comes more than a year after Horner was sacked by Red Bull in July 2025, after 20 years leading the Milton Keynes outfit.
He is understood to have received around £80million in "compensation for loss of office", according to the company's accounts.

The Briton returned to the F1 paddock at the British Grand Prix at Silverstone earlier this year, where he talked about a potential return to the championship. "I've enjoyed my time out. I did 20 years straight with the Red Bull guys. I was obviously doing other stuff before that, so it's the first time I've ever had a bit of time to get off the hamster wheel," he told Sky Sports.
"But for me, I'd only look at doing the right thing, something that really had an opportunity to win at the end of the day."

items.summaryEn: Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton discussed their Las Vegas Grand Prix clash in Qatar, but Ferrari will not reveal details of any solution to its ongoing driver problem. Leclerc was penalised 10 seconds for the collision, which team principal Fred Vasseur called "unacceptable".
detailZh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿已在卡塔尔讨论了他们在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上的碰撞，但法拉利一级方程式车队不会透露解决其持续存在的车手问题的任何“方案”细节。
勒克莱尔因在上周末比赛中与汉密尔顿的碰撞被罚10秒，车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔称该碰撞“不可接受”。
鉴于勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿今年早些时候已发生一系列有争议的冲突，例如在蒙扎和墨西哥，两位车手都面临了媒体关于此次碰撞以及可能发生什么变化的大量提问。
“我们两个人，每人一辆车，我们需要确保事情能够顺利进行。目前，它行不通，”勒克莱尔承认道。
"当然，我可以把某一次事件的责任揽下来，那都无所谓。
"重要的是我们找到一个双方都能接受的折中方案。我们可以讨论拉斯维加斯或其他地方的具体情况，或者之前或之后的圈数，但那并不重要。
"归根结底，在那一刻，只有解决方案才是重要的。"
当被 The Race 问及他是否有关于解决方案的想法时，勒克莱尔回答说："是的，我有，而且我认为我已经表达得很清楚了，但我更愿意在内部进行这些讨论。
“我确实有看法，但最终重要的是我们集体认为什么是正确的决定，这将在内部进行。”
瓦塞尔与两位车手都谈了，勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿周四在卡塔尔媒体会前讨论了该事件，汉密尔顿称会谈“积极”。
但他不愿透露细节。
“一切留在内部，”汉密尔顿说，呼应了勒克莱尔在被问及最后两站是否会实施新比赛规则时“我不能透露”的回答。
法拉利不愿披露任何潜在的比赛规则变更，很可能是因为如果本周末这些规则未被严格遵守，就会招致批评。
汉密尔顿最初在九月初的蒙扎比赛期间呼吁在车手之间引入比赛规则，但他表示这些规则的实施“最终由弗雷德决定”。
“我当时已经把我的观点说清楚了。关于这件事真的没什么更多可说的了。我之前已经表明了我的立场，我的观点并没有真正改变。”
勒克莱尔不愿被拉回重提拉斯维加斯事件的细节，因为当有人向他指出他的赛车与汉密尔顿并排但未被留出空间时，他说：“我真的不想再回到那次冲突上。”
“我只想向前看。我理解你的观点，也认为它很有道理。但与此同时，我不想再回到那次冲突上。”
汉密尔顿表示，在与勒克莱尔缠斗时，他始终把车队放在心上。
当被问及通过沟通能提前规避多少问题时，他说：“你永远无法覆盖所有情况，因为每个场景都不同。但你可以逐弯复盘每一场比赛并讨论各种情况，查尔斯和我已经这么做了。
“总会出现一些你可能没有预见到的新情况。但你也必须依靠直觉，而且归根结底，你始终要把车队放在心上。”
“仅就我个人而言，当我在驾驶时，当我在赛道上攻击任何人时，我总是会想‘好吧，这会如何影响我身后的每一个人？’从车队角度考虑。所以我确实努力尽可能负责任，并在进攻时做出最好的决定，我想。”
当勒克莱尔被问及瓦塞尔的“不可接受”言论时，他回答说：“我的意思是，这当然不可接受。作为一支车队，我们承受不起队友之间的冲突。
“这对每个人来说都非常清楚。特别是拉斯维加斯的那次冲突，正如我所说，我承担了责任。我认为只是存在一些紧张情绪，我们只需要消散它，并确保我们着眼于未来更积极的日子。
“这就是我所寻求的全部。但我确实同意。法拉利两次冲突加在一起，当然是不可接受的。”
汉密尔顿确信他和勒克莱尔会解决这个问题。
“我们会弄清楚的，你知道吗？我们归根结底是队友。而且我认为我们总能学到东西，”汉密尔顿说。
“我们会从这段艰难时期中汲取经验教训。我仍然相信我们在幕后所做的一切建设和努力。我来这里的目标是带领法拉利重返巅峰。这是一个极具挑战性的赛季。人们很容易看到消极的一面，但我更愿意看到今年的积极面：我们正在争夺车队锦标赛的第二名；我们赢得过比赛；我认为今年我们拥有最好的赛车，尤其是在底盘方面。
“所以，我只是努力去看积极的一面，而不是……我觉得大家似乎总是关注消极的东西，这显然是生活中最容易做的事。但我努力记住积极的一面，今年我们确实一起做出了了不起的、一些惊人的事情。”
勒克莱尔也非常希望平息拉斯维加斯站后出现的猜测，即他的合同中存在某种“一号”优先待遇条款。
“我通常从不透露合同内容，但我觉得这一条值得说明，”勒克莱尔说。
“我的合同里绝对没有任何这样的条款。这从来不是我感兴趣的东西，也从来不是我个人想要的。所以没有，我没有。”
“归根结底，这是我们工作的一部分。我认为我唯一不喜欢看到的是人们质疑我对车队的诚信、我对车队的热爱。我从2019年就在法拉利了。我认为我对车队的热爱再清楚不过了。
“为了把法拉利带回巅峰，我会竭尽全力。当然，过程中难免会犯错，而且永远都会。我们只是尽量把错误降到最低，尤其是在队友之间。”
“但我觉得，更让我受伤的是我看到四处流传的那个问号本身。”
“其余的都只是很多噪音，现在并不是最愉快的时期，但这是比赛的一部分，我必须接受。”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton have discussed their Las Vegas Grand Prix clash in Qatar, but the Ferrari Formula 1 team will not reveal details of any "solution" to its ongoing driver problem.
Leclerc was penalised 10 seconds for what team principal Fred Vasseur labelled an "unacceptable" collision between the two drivers during last weekend's race.

Both drivers faced a barrage of questions from the media about the clash and what might change, given Leclerc and Hamilton have had a series of controversial run-ins earlier in the year, such as at Monza and in Mexico.
"We are two, one in each car, and we need to make sure that things just work out. At the moment, it's not working," Leclerc admitted.
"Then, of course, I can take the blame from one episode and whatever. That doesn't really matter.

"It's just important that we find a compromise and a solution that works for both. We can discuss about the specific of Las Vegas or somewhere else, or the laps before or laps after, but that doesn't really matter.
"At the end of the day, it's only the solution that matters in that moment."
Asked by The Race if he had ideas of what the solution could be, Leclerc replied: "Yeah, I do have and I think I've made it very clear, but I would rather have these discussions internally.
"I do have an opinion, but at the end, what matters is what we think is the right decision collectively, and this will take it internally."
Vasseur spoke to both drivers and Leclerc and Hamilton discussed the incident in Qatar on Thursday prior to their media sessions, with Hamilton describing the talks as "positive".
But he was unwilling to disclose the details.
"Everything stays internal," said Hamilton, echoing Leclerc's "I cannot disclose that" answers when asked if there would be new racing rules implemented for the final two rounds.
Ferrari's unwillingness to disclose any potential racing rule changes is likely because it would open it up to criticism if those rules are not strictly followed this weekend.
Hamilton first called for the introduction of racing rules between the drivers at the Monza race in early September, but he said the implementation of them is "for Fred to decide [on] ultimately".
"I made my point clear already back then. There's not really much more to say on it, really. I said my piece before and my point hasn't really changed."

Leclerc did not want to be drawn into revisiting the specifics of the Las Vegas incident as, when it was put to him that he had his car alongside Hamilton's but was not left room, he said: "I don't really want to go back to that clash.
"I just want to look forward. I understand your point and I think it's a valid one. But at the same time, I don't want to go back to that clash."
Hamilton said he has the team in mind when he has been battling Leclerc.

Asked about how much could be preempted with conversations, he said: "You can never cover everything because every scenario is different. But you can go through every single race corner-by-corner and discuss things, which Charles and I have.
"There's always going to be something new that you maybe haven't foreseen. But also you have to use your instinct and you also always, at the core of it, have to have the team [in mind].

"Just speaking for myself, when I'm driving, when I'm attacking whoever it is on track, I'm always thinking 'OK, how is this going to impact everybody behind me?' team-wise. So I really do try to be as responsible as I can and make the best decision when I am attacking, I think."
When Leclerc was asked about Vasseur's "unacceptable" comments, he replied: "I mean that it is unacceptable, of course. As a team, we cannot afford to clash between team-mates.

"That is very clear for everyone. For the clash in particular in Las Vegas, as I said, I took responsibility. I think there's just tension around that we just need to dissipate and make sure that we look at more positive days in the future.
"That's all I'm looking for. But I do agree. It's unacceptable that both Ferrari clashes together, of course."
Hamilton was convinced he and Leclerc would resolve the matter.
"We're going to figure it out, you know? We're team-mates at the end of the day. And I think we always learn," Hamilton said.

"There will be learnings that we take from this difficult period. And I still believe in everything we're building and working towards in the background. I came here with the goal of taking Ferrari back to the top. And it's been a massively challenging season. It's so easy to look at the negatives, but I like to look at the positives this year: we're fighting for second in the constructors' championship; we have had wins; I think we've had the best car, chassis-wise particularly, this year.

“So, I'm just trying to look at the positives and just not...I think everyone seems to be focusing always on the negatives, which is obviously the easiest thing to do in life. But I try to remember the positives and we've really done amazing, some amazing things this year together."
Leclerc was also very keen to squash speculation that emerged after Vegas that he has any kind of '#1' preferential treatment clause in his contract.
"I normally never disclose what I have in my contract, but I think this one is an important one to speak about," Leclerc said.
"And I absolutely have zero clause that says that in my contract. It's never something that I was interested in and never something that I personally wanted. So no, I don't.

"At the end of the day, it's part of our job. I think the only thing that I don't like seeing is people questioning my integrity to the team, my love for the team. I've been in Ferrari since 2019. I think there's nothing clearer than the love I have for the team.

"I'll do absolutely everything in order to bring Ferrari back to the top. Then, of course, mistakes happen along the way and always will. We just try to have to minimise them and particularly between team-mates.
"But I think it's more the question mark of that that I have seen going around that hurts me more than anything else.
"The rest is a lot of noise and it's not the most enjoyable time, but it's part of the game and I have to accept that."

detailZh: 维斯塔潘和乔治·拉塞尔的竞争对赛车运动来说“真的很酷”，F1评论员如是说
天空体育评论员杰米·查德威克认为乔治·拉塞尔比任何其他车手更能挑衅维斯塔潘
维斯塔潘、红牛车队、乔治·拉塞尔、梅赛德斯
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说。关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的比赛分析。
拉斯维加斯大奖赛周末再次点燃了红牛车队和梅赛德斯车队车手，马克斯·维斯塔潘和乔治·罗素之间长期存在的紧张关系，这成为了本周天空体育F1秀播客的讨论焦点。
三届W系列冠军、天空体育评论员杰米·查德威克在播客中讨论了这场重燃的竞争，声称没有其他车手能像罗素那样让维斯塔潘如此烦恼。
这场争执始于最后的练习赛，并在比赛后继续，当时维斯塔潘获胜，而罗素在试图超越他的梅赛德斯车队队友时撞上了墙壁。罗素曾对Sky Italia表示，“得有人站出来对抗那个人”。维斯塔潘的回应是，罗素“远远低于我的水平”，这并不让他烦恼。
查德威克表示她非常了解罗素，而对维斯塔潘了解较少，并给出了她的观点。她说：“这仅仅是在某种程度上个性的极端冲突。我认为没有其他车手能像乔治那样让马克斯如此烦恼。我们在他们之间多次比赛、多种情况和场景中看到了这一点。”
马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
“一方面，对于这项运动来说，有这种竞争真的很酷，因为它让每个人都开始讨论。在某种程度上，它有点像是过去的赛车手时代。但同样，也有点沮丧。”
“她补充说：'马克斯是目前我们这一代中最优秀的车手，他在比赛中证明了这一点。难以置信的天赋。’
“他需要说这样的评论吗？他需要让它影响自己，让自己达到那个水平吗？显然，这对他是种释放，但对我来说，作为一个体育人看到这些，总是感到沮丧，因为他在赛道上取得的每一项成就，我都不觉得他需要把自己拉低到赛道之外的水平。”
这对车手将在本周末的卡塔尔大奖赛再次相遇，该赛事在阿布扎比的赛季决赛前一周举行。
detailEn: Max Verstappen and George Russell rivalry "really cool for the sport", says F1 pundit
Sky Sports pundit Jamie Chadwick believes George Russell provokes Max Verstappen more than any other driver
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.

The Las Vegas Grand Prix weekend reignited the long-running tension between Red Bull and Mercedes drivers, Max Verstappen and George Russell, and it was the talking point of Sky's F1 Show podcast this week.
Three-time W Series champion and Sky Sports pundit Jamie Chadwick discussed the reignited rivalry on the podcast, claiming that no other driver gets under Verstappen's skin as much as Russell.

The row began in final practice and continued after the race, which Verstappen won while Russell hit the wall trying to pass his Mercedes team-mate. Russell had told Sky Italia that "someone's got to stand up to that guy". Verstappen's response was that Russell was "so far below my level" that it did not bother him.

Chadwick said she knows Russell very well and Verstappen less so, and gave her view of what is driving it. "It is just an extreme clash of personalities in a way. I don't think any other driver gets beneath Max's skin as much as George does. We've seen that across multiple races and multiple situations and scenarios between them.
Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes

"On one side it's really cool for the sport to have this kind of rivalry because it gets everyone talking. It's a little bit of times of old, in a way, of drivers of the past. But equally, there's a bit of frustration."
She added: "Max is the best driver of our generation at the moment, proved that in the race. Unbelievable talent.

"Does he need to say comments like that? Does he need to let it get under his skin and let himself go to that level? Clearly it relieves something for him, but for me as a sports person seeing it, it's always frustrating, because everything he achieves on track, I just don't feel like he needs to drag himself down to that off track."
The pair meet again at this weekend's Qatar Grand Prix, which arrives one week before the season finale in Abu Dhabi.

detailZh: 汉密尔顿谈与勒克莱尔最新摩擦：“我们会解决”
在拉斯维加斯最新一次赛道冲突后，汉密尔顿与法拉利的勒克莱尔试图以并列头号车手的身份共处，汉密尔顿对此语气缓和
法拉利车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿表示，他相信自己和队友夏尔·勒克莱尔会“解决”上周拉斯维加斯大奖赛上的最新赛道摩擦。
两周前在墨西哥争夺领先时发生的一起代价高昂的赛道事故曾招致车队领队弗雷德·瓦塞尔的不满，而历史在拉斯维加斯重演：勒克莱尔被认定对与汉密尔顿的接触负有责任，使两位车手都错失了良好成绩。
这次冲突让瓦塞尔更加愤怒，并就如何让他两位头号车手守规矩展开了新的讨论。“这是不可接受的，”瓦塞尔在赛后气愤地说。“这是对车队、对赞助商的不尊重，和墨西哥站之后说的话一样。我认为我们在圣保罗进行了明确的讨论。今天这很不专业。”
周四在多哈发表讲话时，勒克莱尔表示他“非常想与车队一起努力寻找解决方案，以确保我们最大化车队积分，并确保像上周那样的事件不再发生”，但他没有提出任何具体建议。
汉密尔顿也采取了和解的语气，并表示他仍然相信自己能和勒克莱尔作为并列头号车手在车队中和谐共处。
“是的，是的。我们会解决的，”汉密尔顿说。“归根结底我们是队友，我认为我们总是从这些经历中学习，尽管也许看起来不一定如此。但我们会从这段困难时期中吸取教训。
“我依然相信我们在幕后所建设和努力的一切。我们来这里的目标是带领法拉利重返巅峰。”
他补充道：“你确实是在最艰难的时刻学到东西。对弗雷德、查尔斯和我来说，这绝对是极其、极其具有挑战性的时期。但我认为，正是这些时刻，你才能真正学到东西，并通过对话、沟通和坐下来谈心而彼此更加亲近。”
汉密尔顿透露，他和勒克莱尔已经逐一复盘了今年两人之间每一个弯角和每一次事故，其中也包括在蒙扎的一次冲突。但这位七届世界冠军也承认，每一次事故都各不相同、情况动态变化，所以并不像施加严格的比赛规则那么简单。相反，他建议他和勒克莱尔必须凭借本能行事，同时把车队利益放在心上。
“你永远无法覆盖所有情况，因为每个场景都不一样，”汉密尔顿解释道。
“但你确实可以逐场比赛、逐个弯角地复盘讨论，查尔斯和我就这么做过。
“但总会有一些你或许未曾预见的新情况。你还得依靠直觉，而归根结底你始终需要团队。就我而言，当我驾驶时，当我在赛道上进攻任何人时，我总在想：‘好吧，从车队角度考虑，这会如何影响我身后的所有人？’所以，我真的尽力做到尽可能负责，并在进攻时做出最佳决定，我想。
detailEn: Lewis Hamilton on latest Charles Leclerc flashpoint: "We're going to figure it out"
Lewis Hamilton struck a conciliatory tone as he and Ferrari Charles Leclerc try to co-exist as joint-number one drivers after their latest on-track clash in Las Vegas
Ferrari driver Lewis Hamilton says he is confident he and team-mate Charles Leclerc will "figure it out" following their latest on-track skirmish at last week's Las Vegas GP.

Two weeks on from a costly on-track incident fighting for the lead in Mexico, which drew the ire of team boss Fred Vasseur, history repeated itself when Leclerc was found responsible for contact with Hamilton on the streets of Las Vegas, robbing both drivers of a solid result.

The clash prompted more anger from Vasseur and fresh talks over how he will get his two number one drivers in line. "It's unacceptable," Vasseur fumed after the race. "It's a lack of respect for the team, for the sponsors, the same speech as after Mexico. I think we had a clear discussion in Sao Paulo. Today it wasn't professional."

Speaking in Doha on Thursday, Leclerc said he was "very much thinking about trying to find a solution together with the team in order to make sure that we maximise the team points and that episodes like last week don't happen again", stopping short of offering any suggestions.
Hamilton also struck a conciliatory tone and said he was still convinced he and Leclerc could co-exist in harmony at the team as joint number one drivers.

"I do, I do. We're going to figure it out," Hamilton said. "We're team-mates at the end of the day, and I think we always learn from these experiences, whilst maybe it doesn't necessarily look like it. But there will be learnings that we take from this difficult period.
"I still believe in everything we're building and working towards in the background. We came here with the goal of taking Ferrari back to the top."

He added: "You learn really through the hardest times. And these are definitely very, very challenging times for Fred and Chares and I. But think these are the moments that you really learn and grow closer together through conversation and communicating and having those sit-downs."

Hamilton revealed he and Leclerc have gone through every corner and every incident between the pair this year, which also included a clash at Monza. But the seven-time world champion also acknowledged every incident is different and dynamic, so it's not as simple as imposing strict racing rules. Instead, he suggested that he and Leclerc have to use their instinct while keeping the team's interests in the back of their minds.
"You can never cover everything, because every scenario is different," Hamilton explained.
"But you can definitely go through every single race, corner by corner, and discuss things, which Charles and I have.

"But there's always going to be something new that you maybe haven't foreseen. You also have to use your instinct, and at the core you always have to have the team. Speaking for myself, when I'm driving, when I'm attacking, whoever it is on track, I'm always thinking: 'OK, how is this going to impact everybody behind me, team-wise?' So, I really do try to be as responsible as I can, and make the best decision when I am attacking, I think."

致法拉利车迷。来自马拉内罗及更广范围的最新法拉利F1新闻、车手动态、技术分析和比赛反应。
查尔斯·勒克莱尔周四走进洛赛尔国际赛车场的FIA新闻发布会时，清楚聚光灯仍会牢牢对准法拉利的车库。在拉斯维加斯大奖赛上让队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿打转五天后——并且承受了车队领队弗雷德里克·瓦塞尔赛后直率的严厉批评——这位摩纳哥车手没有试图回避后续影响，尽管他对详细说明马拉内罗计划如何防止此事再次发生关上了门。
“我知道弗雷德（瓦塞尔）的立场，作为车手我必须接受，”勒克莱尔说。“我们都是实力强劲的车手，都希望跑在对方前面。不幸的是，最近发生了太多事故。”
勒克莱尔的悔意出现在2026赛季动荡的最后阶段之后，这段时期反复考验着法拉利“两位一号车手”的理念。此前在蒙扎已有摩擦，随后在墨西哥城又发生首圈4号弯的冲突——当时勒克莱尔在挑战杆位得主汉密尔顿的过程中驶上草地，并被罚时五秒，而马克斯·维斯塔潘趁机穿过并最终以0.799秒的优势夺冠——瓦塞尔于是在圣保罗让两位车手坐下来当面把话说开。
那次和解只维持了不到一场比赛。在拉斯维加斯，勒克莱尔从第10位发车，正好排在汉密尔顿（第11位）前面，比赛后段他在7号弯的猛烈插入导致七届世界冠军打转，勒克莱尔因此被罚时10秒，两人最终分别以第七和第十完赛，仅带回可怜的七个积分。

赛车甚至还没抵达封闭停车区，瓦塞尔的怒火就已经清晰可闻；他在冷却圈通过无线电把勒克莱尔叫来，要求他“先来见我，其他事都往后放”。随后面对记者，这位法拉利领队明确表示那次交流完全是单向的：“不，那不是讨论——是我在说！”他称这次碰撞“不可接受”，是“对车队、对赞助商缺乏尊重”，并在接受天空体育意大利台采访时更进一步，警告两位车手之间的状况“正变得难以管理”，原因是“他们两人之间存在人与人之间的误解，而不是他们与车队之间有误解”。
为什么勒克莱尔不愿讨论法拉利的“交战规则”
在卡塔尔，勒克莱尔完全站在了他的老板一边，同时明确区分了赛道外的和谐与轮对轮的紧张。
“解决方案？我不能详细谈论交战规则，”勒克莱尔说。“不过，我认为外界关注度非常高，但最重要的是找到尽可能避免问题的解决方案。我们正在做，但我不能谈论它。我为拉斯维加斯承担了责任，但我同意瓦塞尔的看法，两辆法拉利之间的接触是不可接受的。
“刘易斯和我已经谈过寻找解决方案，我相信我们在赛道外的关系非常牢固。然后这个问题又在赛道上出现了，这正是我们需要找到解决方案的地方，但正如我所说，我不想谈论它，也不想再回顾那次事件。”
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
勒克莱尔不愿讨论正式准则，这与瓦塞尔本人在内华达州所持的怀疑态度如出一辙。当被问及法拉利是否终于需要白纸黑字的书面比赛规则时，瓦塞尔予以反驳，坚称：“老实说，这不是规则的问题……你没法把它写在纸上……他们只需要以专业的方式行事。”
在洛赛尔周五练习赛之前，瓦塞尔在法拉利官方周末前瞻中语气更为平静，以目标为导向。他说：“我们前往卡塔尔，决心作为一个团队做出回应，并交付我们对自己所期望的那种周末。”他强调，法拉利的目标是“让两辆赛车都带回一个扎实的成绩”。
在积分榜上，法拉利实际上正处于完成其剩余主要车队目标的边缘。梅赛德斯已以666分加冕车队冠军，法拉利则以517分位居第二——领先第三名红牛（440分）77分，领先迈凯伦（431分）86分，而在卡塔尔和下周阿布扎比收官战中还剩下86分。周日只需拿到10分——无论是通过一个前五名完赛，还是常规的双车积分入账——无论对手如何表现，马拉内罗都将锁定第二名。
然而，就个人而言，荣誉依然岌岌可危：汉密尔顿以267分位列车手积分榜第三进入卢赛尔站——仅领先乔治·拉塞尔和兰多·诺里斯三分——而勒克莱尔以250分落后17分，还剩两场比赛来缩小差距。卡塔尔强制性的27圈轮胎上限将周日的比赛变成一场全速的战略冲刺，法拉利两位明星车手之间的干净执行，将比周四新闻发布室里说的任何话都更能说明问题。
detailEn: Charles Leclerc refuses to reveal Ferrari's "rules of engagement" after Lewis Hamilton crash
Charles Leclerc agrees Ferrari contact is "unacceptable" and confirms private talks with Lewis Hamilton before Qatar GP
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.

Charles Leclerc walked into Thursday’s FIA press conference at the Losail International Circuit knowing the spotlight would stay locked on Ferrari’s garage. Five days after spinning team-mate Lewis Hamilton at the Las Vegas Grand Prix - and absorbing a blunt post-race dressing-down from team principal Fred Vasseur - the Monegasque driver did not attempt to dodge the fallout, even as he shut the door on detailing how Maranello plans to stop it from happening again.

"I knew what Fred’s position was, and as a driver I have to accept it," Leclerc said. "We are strong drivers who want to finish ahead of each other. Unfortunately, too many incidents have happened recently."

Leclerc’s contrition follows a turbulent final stretch of the 2026 campaign that has repeatedly tested Ferrari’s two-No. 1 philosophy. After earlier friction at Monza and an opening-lap Turn 4 clash in Mexico City - where Leclerc cut the grass while challenging polesitter Hamilton and picked up a five-second penalty as Max Verstappen slipped through to win by 0.799 seconds - Vasseur sat both drivers down in São Paulo to clear the air.

That truce lasted barely one race. In Las Vegas, where Leclerc started 10th directly ahead of Hamilton in 11th, a late-race lunge into Turn 7 spun the seven-time champion and landed Leclerc a 10-second penalty, leaving the pair seventh and 10th for a meagre seven-point haul.

Vasseur’s fury was audible before the cars even reached parc fermé; he summoned Leclerc over cooldown-lap radio to see him "before anything else". Speaking to reporters afterwards, the Ferrari boss made clear the exchange was strictly one-way: "No, it was not a discussion – I spoke!" Calling the collision "unacceptable" and "a lack of respect for the team, for the sponsors," Vasseur went even further with Sky Italia, warning that the situation between his drivers was "becoming unmanageable" due to "a human misunderstanding between them, not between them and the team".
Why Leclerc won’t discuss Ferrari’s “rules of engagement”
In Qatar, Leclerc aligned himself squarely with his boss while drawing a clear line between off-track harmony and wheel-to-wheel tension.

"The solution? I can't go into detail and talk about the rules of engagement," Leclerc said. "However, I believe there is a very high level of external attention, but the most important thing is to find a solution to avoid problems as much as possible. We are doing it, but I can't talk about it. I took responsibility for Las Vegas, but I agree with Vasseur that contact between two Ferraris is unacceptable.

"Lewis and I have already spoken to find a solution, and I believe our relationship off the track is very strong. Then the issue came up again on the track, and that’s where we need to find a solution, but as I said, I don’t want to talk about it or go back over the incident."
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

Leclerc’s reluctance to discuss formal guidelines mirrors Vasseur’s own scepticism in Nevada. Asked whether Ferrari finally needed written racing rules on paper, Vasseur pushed back, insisting: "Honestly, it's not a matter of rules... You can't put it on the paper... They just have to act in a professional way."

Ahead of Friday practice at Losail, Vasseur struck a calmer, target-driven tone in Ferrari’s official weekend preview. "We head to Qatar determined to respond as a team and deliver the kind of weekend we expect from ourselves," he said, emphasising that the Scuderia’s goal is to "bring home a solid result with both cars".

On the scoreboard, Ferrari actually stands on the brink of wrapping up its main remaining team objective. With Mercedes already crowned Constructors’ champions on 666 points, Ferrari holds second on 517—a 77-point cushion over third-placed Red Bull (440) and 86 ahead of McLaren (431) with 86 points left across Qatar and next week’s Abu Dhabi finale. Scoring just 10 points on Sunday - whether through a single top-five finish or a routine double-points haul - seals P2 for Maranello regardless of what its rivals do.

Individually, however, pride remains sharply on the line: Hamilton enters Losail third in the Drivers’ standings on 267 points—just three ahead of George Russell and Lando Norris - while Leclerc sits 17 points back on 250 with two races left to close the gap. With Qatar’s mandatory 27-lap tyre cap turning Sunday into a flat-out strategic sprint, clean execution between Ferrari’s two stars will tell far more than anything said in Thursday’s press room.

在2026年F1赛季下半程，勒克莱尔和汉密尔顿这对法拉利车手已经多次发生冲突，冲突发生在蒙扎、赞德福特和墨西哥，最近一次在拉斯维加斯。
上周末，勒克莱尔试图在7号弯内超越汉密尔顿，但因此造成打滑，被罚了10秒，这让车队老板弗雷德·瓦瑟尔非常愤怒。
法国人在冷却圈通过车队无线电说：“查尔斯，我想要你在比赛结束前出现在那里，其他都不重要。”
现在一周后，在卡塔尔，勒克莱尔承认了这次“不可接受”的碰撞的责任，但否认了任何他试图成为法拉利一号车手的统治地位的言论。
“我的合同里绝对没有这样的条款，”勒克莱尔说，他在六月份签署了一份“多年”续约合同。“这从来不是我所感兴趣的，也从来不是我所想要的。”"
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
所以不，我不这么认为。我认为我唯一不喜欢看到的是人们质疑我对车队，对团队的热爱。我从2019年就加入了法拉利。
我认为我对团队的热爱是最清晰的，我会尽我所能让法拉利重返巅峰。
当然，在过程中总会犯错误，而且总会发生。我们只需要尽量减少这些错误，尤其是在队友之间。
“但是，我认为我看到的那个疑问符比我看到的任何其他东西都更让我受伤。”
“其余的都是很多噪音，这不是最愉快的时光，但它是比赛的一部分，我必须接受这一点。”
莱科斯坚持认为他与七次世界冠军的关系仍然“非常好”，声称很多谈话的升级是由于为法拉利驾驶的性质。
查尔斯·莱科斯，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
因此，车队正在通过几次内部讨论来寻找解决方案，这些讨论是在墨西哥事件之后开始的，当时汉密尔顿批评勒克莱尔对比赛的“孤注一掷”态度。
“至少还有一年时间在一起，我们必须为车队做到最好，”勒克莱尔说，汉密尔顿的合同将于2027年底到期。
“所以，我认为我一直在思考如何与车队一起寻找解决方案，以确保我们最大化车队积分，并且像上周那样的情况不再发生。
“这是我的首要任务。我们非常专注于寻找一个可行的解决方案，尤其是因为我真的相信我们正处于良好的势头。”
“如果明年我们要争夺冠军，那么找到正确的解决方案，对我们双方来说就更加重要，以便将法拉利带回顶峰。”
勒克莱尔最终在拉斯维加斯获得第10名，而汉密尔顿高出三个位置，这使得法拉利在最后一轮和下一轮比赛（卡塔尔和阿布扎比）之前仍然位居车手积分榜第二。
detailEn: Charles Leclerc urges "solution" after several clashes with Lewis Hamilton
The Ferrari duo have tangled several times since the 2026 F1 summer break
Charles Leclerc was left furious by those ‘questioning his integrity and love for Ferrari’ after yet another clash with Formula 1 team-mate Lewis Hamilton - having urged to find a “solution”.
The Ferrari pair have been at loggerheads several times during the second half of the 2026 F1 campaign, clashing at Monza, Zandvoort and Mexico before their latest spat in Las Vegas.
Last weekend Leclerc attempted to overtake Hamilton for sixth down the inside of Turn 7, but copped a 10-second penalty for causing a spin - leaving team boss Fred Vasseur furious.
The Frenchman said on team radio during the cooldown lap: “Charles, I want to see you at the end of the race, before anything else.”
Now a week later in Qatar, Leclerc has accepted responsibility for the “unacceptable” clash but refuted any theory that he is attempting to establish dominance as Ferrari’s number one driver.

“I absolutely have zero clause that says that in my contract,” said Leclerc, who signed a “multi-year” renewal in June. “It's never something that I was interested in and never something that I personally wanted.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
“So no, I don't. I think the only thing that I don't like seeing is people questioning my integrity to the team, my love for the team. I've been in Ferrari since 2019.
“I think there's nothing clearer than the love I have for the team and I'll do absolutely everything in order to bring Ferrari back to the top.
“Then, of course, mistakes happen along the way and always will. We just have to minimise them and particularly between team-mates.
“But yeah, I think it's more the question mark of that that I have seen going around that hurts me more than anything else.
“The rest is a lot of noise and it's not the most enjoyable time, but it's part of the game and I have to accept that.”
Leclerc then insisted that the relationship between him and the seven-time world champion is still “very good”, claiming much of the talk has been heightened due to the nature of driving for Ferrari.
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari
So the team is striving to find a solution with several internal discussions, which started in the aftermath of the Mexico incident amid Hamilton criticising Leclerc’s “do or die” attitude to racing.
“At least one more year together, we've got to do the best for the team,” said Leclerc, with Hamilton’s current contract expiring at the end of 2027.

“So, I think I've been very much thinking about trying to find a solution together with the team in order to make sure that we maximise the team points and that episodes like last week don't happen again.
“That is my main priority. We're just really very much focused on trying to find a solution that works and particularly because I really believe we are in a good momentum.
“If next year we are to be in a position of fighting for the championship, it's even more important to find the right solution for both of us to bring Ferrari back to the top.”
Leclerc eventually finished 10th in Vegas with Hamilton three spots higher, leaving Ferrari still second in the championship ahead of the final two rounds: Qatar and Abu Dhabi.

大卫·克罗夫特认为维斯塔潘结合了阿隆索的战略头脑与明显的速度优势
费尔南多·阿隆索、阿斯顿·马丁车队、维斯塔潘、红牛车队
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说。关注红牛车队，获取F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的赛事分析。
天空体育一级方程式首席解说员大卫·克罗夫特认为，在马克斯·维斯塔潘的比赛中看到了费尔南多·阿隆索的聪明才智，但他补充说，这位四次世界冠军拥有更多的速度。
在维斯塔潘在拉斯维加斯大奖赛获胜后，克罗夫特在天空体育F1秀播客节目中被要求总结他对这位红牛车手的观察。他首先将他与其他仍在45岁高龄参赛的两届世界冠军进行了比较。
克罗夫特表示，维斯塔潘已经拥有了定义阿隆索职业生涯的品质，而且更多。他说：“马克斯拥有费尔南多·阿隆索拥有的东西，但还有更多的速度。这是在比赛中战略思考和准确知道自己在做什么的能力。但实际上，他比费尔南多·阿隆索更快。”
这种能力在拉斯维加斯比赛的最后几圈得到了展示，克罗夫特说，维斯塔潘宁愿在最后一圈跑第二，也不愿领先。他认为梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔有不同的计划。
“这就是他为什么要对基米做出那样的动作，因为他想接着对马克斯做出动作，然后领先。马克斯想要第二的位置。这几乎就像是一场自行车赛场的冲刺比赛，”他补充道。
克罗夫特对这会让维斯塔潘处于什么位置没有丝毫怀疑，即使他并不总是赞同这位荷兰人的说法或行为。
“他现在是全能的完美车手，”他说。 “无论你对他说的话有什么看法，无论你对他在赛道上的一些行为有什么看法，毫无疑问，他是目前赛道上最伟大的车手。而且，在同等机械下要打败他需要付出很多努力，这使得明年变得非常吸引人。”
梅赛德斯车手基米·安东内利在墨西哥大奖赛中赢得了车手冠军头衔，但维斯塔潘正在为第二名而战。这位29岁的车手目前以304分排在第二位，法拉利的刘易斯·汉密尔顿以267分排在第三位。
detailEn: David Croft: Max Verstappen has Fernando Alonso's race intelligence but is faster
David Croft believes Max Verstappen combines the strategic brain of Fernando Alonso with a clear speed advantage
Fernando Alonso, Aston Martin Racing, Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Sky Sports Formula 1 lead commentator David Croft sees Fernando Alonso's smart racing in Max Verstappen, but adds that the four-time champion has more speed.

Speaking on Sky Sports' F1 Show podcast after Verstappen's Las Vegas Grand Prix win, Croft was asked to sum up what he had seen from the Red Bull driver. He started by comparing him with the two-time champion who is still racing at 45.

Croft said Verstappen already has the quality that has defined Alonso's career, and then some. "Max has got what Fernando Alonso has got, but more pace to go with it," Croft explained. "And that's an ability to strategise and think your way through a race and know exactly what you're doing at all times. But he's actually faster than Fernando Alonso."

That ability was on show in the closing laps in Las Vegas, where Croft said Verstappen was happy to run second into the final lap rather than lead it. He felt Mercedes' George Russell had a different plan.
"That's why he went for the move on Kimi, because he wanted to then make the move on Max and be out in front. Max wanted to be second. It was almost like a cycling velodrome sprint race," he added.
Croft was in no doubt where that leaves Verstappen, even if he does not always approve of what the Dutchman says or does.

"He is just the all-round complete driver at the moment," he said. "And whatever you think about what he says, whatever you think about what he does sometimes on track, there is no doubting he is the current greatest driver on the track. And you're going to have to go some to beat him in equal machinery, which makes next year so fascinating."

Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli claimed the drivers' championship title at the Mexican Grand Prix, but Verstappen is fighting for second. The 29-year-old currently sits second with 304 points, with Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton in third with 267 points.
